title: RexxOS Grid LDAP Identity runtime qualification — dev17
summary: Grid dev17 fixes an invalid ooRexx test loader and returns UNAUTHENTICATED for malformed RPC context; both native r13196 tests passed locally.
invariants: LDAP Identity dev22 is the principal and ACL authority, not Grid; caller attribution comes from an authenticated external layer.
Only Directory/Table RPC context is admitted; malformed context denies explicitly.
Active principal with GRID.ESTATE.READ succeeds, while management capability without grant, missing principal and disabled principal are denied.
Transport packet ACK and authenticated LDAP authorization are not evidence of RTO2 committed MI work.
Neither 20/20 live work nor named-service XTP federation is accepted.
procedure: Run tests/run_native_qualification.sh with the exact r13196 interpreter and pinned LDAP Identity dev22, RPC core dev1 and Grid dev15 dependencies.

provenance.claim: Malformed RPC context is denied before consulting principal_id.
